NOTE: Proforma net income and EPS for Q4 1995 exclude a special after-tax charge of $133.1 million related to restructuring and an $8.0 million charge related to the sale of the company's investment in a Mexican joint venture. Including charges, the company reported a Q4 1995 loss of $3.48 a share.

NOTE: Proforma net and EPS for 12 months ended November 30, 1996 exclude store-closing charge, an asset impairment charge, a federal income tax benefit and related interest income. Including the non-routine items, the company reported a Q4 net loss of $0.63 a share.

NOTE: Proforma net income and EPS for 12 months ended November 30, 1995 exclude a special after-tax charge of $133.1 million related to restructuring and an $8.0 million charge related to the sale of the company's investment in a Mexican joint venture.
